claim: For Poland as of 2026-08-28, the current comparison is M5 MacBook Air versus 14/16-inch MacBook Pro with M5-family options; the Air starts lower and is lighter/silent, while the Pro adds higher-tier chips, active cooling, more ports and display/memory headroom.
scope: Current Polish Apple lineup and list prices; checkout configuration changes total price.

claim: For sustained professional video editing, the Pro is the safer recommendation because active cooling and M5 Pro/Max options preserve performance on long exports and complex timelines; the Air remains reasonable for mobile, shorter or proxy-based work when silence, weight and price dominate.
scope: Recommendation assumes recurring sustained workloads; exact codec, resolution, effects, memory need and budget were not supplied.
